missed_correctness_gold.title: Using retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 reads a possibly stale value and can lose increments under concurrency; consid
missed_correctness_gold.description: Using retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 reads a possibly stale value and can lose increments under concurrency; consider an atomic increment via Prisma (increment: 1) to avoid race conditions (also applies to the similar update in the catch block).

adjudication.why: The new retry updates assign the stale fetched retryCount plus one. Overlapping cron invocations can overwrite one another rather than atomically incrementing the retry count.

missed_correctness_gold.title: The deletion logic in scheduleSMSReminders.ts incorrectly deletes non-SMS workflow reminders (e.g., Email, WhatsApp) tha
missed_correctness_gold.description: The deletion logic in scheduleSMSReminders.ts incorrectly deletes non-SMS workflow reminders (e.g., Email, WhatsApp) that have retryCount > 1. This occurs because the retryCount condition within the OR clause for deletion lacks a method: WorkflowMethods.SMS filter, causing it to apply to all reminder types instead of only SMS reminders, which is the intended scope of this function.

adjudication.why: The new retryCount > 1 OR branch lacks method: SMS, so deleteMany applies it to reminders for every method. The previous method filter scoped the whole delete to SMS.

promotion_candidates.title: Retry-count bump inside `catch` can throw and abort the whole cron run
promotion_candidates.description: Row can be deleted during batch processing, causing the retry-count update at line 190 to throw P2025. Since this throw occurs inside a catch block, it escapes the loop and skips all remaining reminders, causing the endpoint to 500.

promotion_candidates.title: SMS-lock is counted as a retryable failure, permanently deleting pending reminders
promotion_candidates.description: SMS-lock state from twilio.scheduleSMS is treated as a retryable failure and incremented at line 178. Reminders with retryCount > 1 are hard-deleted, so teams locked for ~45 minutes permanently lose all pending reminders in the 7-day window with no logging.
